name: Blade trap
description: A machete bolted to a small engine's shaft. A tug on the wire opens the throttle and the blade sweeps everything around it.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. Drawn as a two-stroke engine on a plank with the machete flat on its output hub, reaching out to one side. The blade sticks out 55 cm past a compact engine, so the bounding box is mostly air. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Nailboard
description: Planks with nails driven up through them. Anyone who steps on it takes a nail through the foot.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. Three boards on two battens with a grid of nails. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Booby trap
description: A tape-bound can of explosive with a pull pin on a string. Tug the string and it goes off.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. A taped tin can with a striker nail, pull pin and coiled string. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Bubble wrap
description: A roll of plastic sheet full of air bubbles. Laid on the floor, it pops loudly when stepped on.
notes: Drawn as a roll with its end pulled out to show the bubbles; the sheet is light, so the roll is kept small. The film is see-through in game; the tiles draw it opaque. A hollow roll's box is mostly air. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Caltrops
description: A handful of small iron spikes that always land with one point up. Scatter them to lame whatever walks through.
notes: The whole handful is one item, so the row draws five caltrops. Police and military usage reflects tyre-spike and area-denial stocks; drop it if caltrops stay craft-only. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Glass caltrops
description: Lumps of glue bristling with broken glass. Scatter them where something will walk.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. Four lumps of amber glue with glass shards set edge out; the tiles draw the glass opaque. The handful is one item. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Tooth caltrops
description: Lumps of glue set with long pointed teeth. Scatter them where something will walk.
notes: Made by the player from teeth of large creatures, so usage is empty. Four glue lumps bristling with teeth. The handful is one item. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Crossbow trap
description: A loaded crossbow lashed to a board with a cord on its trigger. It shoots once when the wire is pulled, then needs reloading.
notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. A pistol crossbow lashed to a board, bolt on the rail, trigger cord running to a tripwire coil. The prod spans 50 cm across a slim stock, so the box is mostly air. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Land mine
description: A buried mine that springs up and bursts when stepped on. Handle it with care.
notes: A bounding fragmentation mine with a three-prong pressure fuze and a safety pin ring. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

name: Light snare kit
description: A wire noose on a pole, two stakes, a mallet and cord. Catches small game alive.
notes: Laid out flat: an 80 cm snare pole with its noose, two stakes, a mallet and a hank of cord. Hunting usage reflects trapping supplies. The parts laid out leave empty space in the box. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.

notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. Two capped pipes strapped to a board with rubber-band strikers and a pin cord to a tripwire coil. Long and slim, so its box is mostly air. name: Tripwire

notes: Made by the player, so usage is empty. A cord hank with a brass screw eye tied to each end. Set as a trap; the bear trap's `trap` block in items-tools.libsonnet is the model for its tuning, left to integration.
